axis_supply.supply_status: Adequate for static defensive operations, critically strained for sustained offensive operations. Primary constraints: fuel delivery from Tripoli (800km) and Benghazi (400km), limited water transport capacity in desert environment, dependency on coastal road network vulnerable to interdiction. Italian motorized divisions required higher fuel consumption than infantry divisions.

allied_supply.supply_status: Transitional - 90% of allotted transport and 90% of arms/equipment by end of June 1941. Division not yet considered ready for operations at start of Q3. Vehicles mostly carried over from East Africa campaign showing wear. Re-equipment ongoing through August-September. Supply situation improving as desert supply chains established from Egyptian depots.
